purpose: Define the transport envelope for DWH remote payloads, preserving text/binary-file payload constraints, origin metadata, schema/binding identity and cryptographic/session metadata independently from domain semantics.

topics.name: DWH Transport Envelope
topics.purpose: Define the transport envelope for DWH remote payloads, preserving text/binary-file payload constraints, origin metadata, schema/binding identity and cryptographic/session metadata independently from domain semantics.

semantics.envelope_rule: Transport envelope carries origin, target/binding, payload type and required provenance/security metadata.
semantics.webrtc_rule: WebRTC may provide the peer transport.
semantics.crypto_rule: PGP/session-key protection and handshake metadata are transport/security concerns and do not redefine payload semantics.
semantics.md5_rule: Where legacy/current handshake contract specifies MD5, its role is handshake compatibility/integrity metadata only and not semantic identity.
semantics.domain_rule: Transport envelope never becomes owner of domain payload semantics.
semantics.validation_rule: Unsupported payload type or invalid envelope fails before domain dispatch.

invariants.rule: DWH data movement preserves explicit origin identity, schema, scope and remote authority boundaries; transport connectivity never becomes data authority.

hard_gates.condition: crypto metadata treated as payload semantics

references.purpose: DWH may use WebRTC peer transport.

prose.summary: Define the transport envelope for DWH remote payloads, preserving text/binary-file payload constraints, origin metadata, schema/binding identity and cryptographic/session metadata independently from domain semantics.
